title: The 2-Quasi-Regularizability Conjecture and Independence Polynomials of Wp Graphs
summary: Hoang, Levit, Mandrescu and Pham asked for structural conditions ensuring that the independence polynomial of a $\W_p$ graph is log-concave, or at least unimodal, and conjectured that a connected $\W_2$ graph is $2$-quasi-regularizable if and only if $n(G)\ge 3α(G)$ (2026). We prove the conjecture. The key point is a local expansion theorem: if $G$ is connected and belongs to $\W_2$, then every non-maximum independent set $A$ satisfies \[ |N_G(A)|\ge 2|A|. \] Thus the only possible obstruction to $2$-quasi-regularizability in a connected $\W_2$ graph comes from maximum independent sets,…
